s.d: A woman who has an excessive libido
Originally, the DuPont company trade name for polyamide, a copolymer whose molecules consist of alternating diamine and dicarboxylic acid…
Any female nature spirit associated with water, forests, grottos, wind, etc
Used before different, before comparatives with more and less, and idiomatically before other comparatives
A no; a negative response (in a Russian context)
Excess of sexual behaviour or desire in women
